about_the_game:
"What freedoms does an individual have to sacrifice in order to fit in with society?
There is no universal answer, but the freedom to kill with your mind
seems like a damn good start."

Crimson Silk takes place in a world where extrasensory powers are real, dangerous, and heavily regulated to a point of oppression.

  • 8 unique endings, and each one gets you a little closer to the ultimate answer. Would you rather work with the police or a shady information broker? Do both to learn the truth.

  • About 30 characters, from superhuman detectives to double-crossing ministers. (includes a telepathic sidekick!)

  • No-sweat adventure gameplay that respects both your time and your brain. Explore the locations, investigate the leads, take it slow. Or skim right past for the juicy story; the choice is yours.

  • Frame-by-frame animation in cutscenes. Every pixel on the screen is put down with intention, every frame is crafted by hand.

  • Colorful environments you can revisit and explore.

While you’re looking for answers, someone is looking for you. One wrong move can mean death, and sometimes there is no way around it: the enemy knows more than you do.

Try again.

Pick another lead, trust another shady figure. Obtain a useful connection in a different timeline, and you might be able to bypass the roadblock. Or not.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains low-detail depictions of violence and gore.

short_description: Crimson Silk is a side-scrolling adventure, a political murder mystery with a mind-controlling villain. Investigate a parliamentarian's assassination across an intertwined branching story. Use psychic powers and past life connections — and try not to catch a full head of lead.
